The '''Battle of Tarawa ''' was a battle fought early during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] at [[Tarawa]], between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] managed to destroy a fleet of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] with [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighters]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Tarawa shares its name with the real-world [[Wikipedia:Battle of Tarawa|Battle of Tarawa]], a major [[Wikipedia:United States|American]] offensive during [[Wikipedia:World War II|World War II]].
